title: Baby Flying Squirrel Takes Flight for the First Time | Mammals | BBC Earth

segments.description: Medium action shot of a Siberian flying squirrel launching off a snow-covered tree trunk and gliding smoothly through the winter air.
Close-up shot of a tiny flying squirrel peering out from a hollow tree cavity in the snowy forest.
Medium tracking shot of the flying squirrel clinging to a birch tree trunk and darting upward under cold winter lighting.
Dynamic wide shot of the flying squirrel spreading its membrane wings wide and gliding gracefully across the snow-draped forest.
Macro close-up shot focusing on the squirrel's furry gliding membrane stretching between its wrists and ankles.
Close-up shot of a baby flying squirrel nibbling on pine needles inside the safety of its winter nest.
Medium close-up shot inside the dark woodpecker nest hole revealing mother and baby flying squirrels huddled together to stay warm.
Wide shot of blossoming spring cherry tree branches transitioning the forest into warmer weather as young squirrels prepare to leave the nest.
Medium shot of young flying squirrels peeking out from their nest hole and climbing up the tree trunk for their first flight.
Medium action shot of a confident baby flying squirrel launching off a branch and gliding successfully to a nearby trunk.
Close-up shot of the hesitant baby flying squirrel retreating back into its cozy nest hole, concluding the wildlife segment.
